rule: Point release on v003.2. Part art is byte-identical. pose numbers are identical EXCEPT poses.knockout (stagger key of the new fall) and poses.follow_through.axe (visor-clear). Clips are re-baked.

poses_changed_why.knockout: Still the stagger key of the knockout clip; the clip itself now holds the floor squash 3–4 frames and eases 8–10 frames into the v003.1 defeat kneel.
poses_changed_why.follow_through.axe: Static leftover key: weapon pixels on the visor in v003.2 (35 px). Arms re-solved; body and legs unchanged; 0 weapon px on the face, off-hand still on the haft.

clip_changes: Knockout settle (floor hold + ease into defeat). Dagger attack gained a coil→extend in-between and a smear that covers coil-to-extension. Axe recovery and hit_react no longer flip upper_arm_r >45°/frame. Every clip frame is angle-unwrapped with per-part velocity ≤ 45°/frame.
renderer_changes_required: Same playback contract as v003.2 (baked frames at 30 fps, no runtime IK). Use the new clips.json; frame counts and some contact indices may have shifted.
Knockout: the floor squash is held, then eases into poses.defeat (last frame is matrix-identical to the approved v003.1 defeat pose). No bounce key.
Dagger smears on the thrust are authored from the coil pose so the trail covers the full travel; still z 84, still visor-cleared.
Engines that clamp joints must take any widened motion_bounds in this manifest.
